## Ownership and scope
- Refs #ISSUE
- Accountable agent/assignee:
- Status: `status:in-review`
- Related upstream/downstream PRs and issue dependencies:
- SUT version/commit:
- OpenSpec:
- ADR, or why not necessary:

## Implementation
What and why changed? Include behavior, risks, migration/rollback and files touched.

## Acceptance evidence
- [ ] Positive/negative acceptance criteria verified
- [ ] Commands, platform, runner, outputs and current PR SHA recorded
- [ ] Current-head required CI passing (URLs)
- [ ] Web/Appium/Wopee screenshots or execution artifacts linked when relevant, without mislabeling fixtures
- [ ] Security, accessibility, data and credentials reviewed
- [ ] Separate review passes/delegated reviewer findings documented; no fabricated independent approval
- [ ] OpenSpec tasks and relevant docs updated

## Fresh-agent handoff
- Latest pushed SHA:
- Verified and unverified:
- Blocker / owner / unblocking condition:
- One exact next action:

## Merge gate
Merge proactively **only** when required CI/approvals and acceptance criteria pass. Record merge SHA in originating Issue, delete branch and set Done only after verification.
